snippet.title: Kalanoro - Gameplay Overview | AG French Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Kalanoro appears in a commented gameplay overview featuring new environments. This action-adventure platformer, inspired by Malagasy folklore, lets you build a band of lemur artists. Coming summer 2026 to PC, PS5, Xbox Series and Switch (↓)
